name: Plank
instructions: Keep your elbows directly under your shoulders
Your body should form a straight line from head to heels
Don't lift your hips up or drop them down
Engage your abdominal muscles

name: Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart
Knees aligned with toes, don't let them cave in
Chest up and core engaged
Hip should reach knee level (90 degrees)

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Elbowed directly under your shoulders
Only the forearm should move
Exhale while lifting upward
Inhale while lowering
Lower the weight in a controlled manner

name: Push-up
instructions: Stand sideways to the camera so your whole body is visible
Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees
Push back up to full arm extension

name: Lunge
instructions: Stand sideways to the camera
Step forward and lower your hips until both knees are bent around 90 degrees
Front knee should stay above the ankle, not past the toes
Push back up through the front heel to the starting position
commonMistakes: Front knee going past the toes
Leaning the torso too far forward
Back knee slamming into the ground

name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Start with elbows bent at shoulder height
Press upward until your arms are fully extended overhead
Lower back down in a controlled manner
Keep your core engaged, avoid arching your back

name: Sit-up
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the ground
Position the camera to your side
Curl your torso up toward your knees
Lower back down with control, don't let your head slam down
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of controlled movement

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the ground
Position the camera to your side
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control
commonMistakes: Not lifting the hips high enough
Overarching the lower back at the top
Feet too far from the hips

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand facing the camera so your whole body is visible
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead
Jump back to the starting position with arms at your sides
Keep a steady, controlled rhythm
